text: The enclosure near the grand stand
why: ¶190 says the drag drew up in the enclosure near the grand stand.
Watson glances at 'the card' to see the entries, which is the race card.

text: Race day: in the drag by the grand stand, before the race
why: They came to Winchester to see the race; the drag is in the enclosure, and Watson is reading the entries, so the race has not yet run.
